text: The end of the game is triggered when:
« Any one player places their last cube on the Action star on their Action board, or
Reaches the final space on one of the 3 Development tracks
Play continues until each player has had the same number of turns i.e. play ends at the end
of the turn of the player to the right of the player with the First Player marker.
Important: From the moment the end of the game is triggered, no player can move their units to
or from the Atlantis Territories.
Once the last player has completed their turn, proceed to final scoring. Each player earns
Victory Points as follows:
1. Assess the position of each player's markers on each of the 3 Development tracks;
War, Commerce, and Technology:
a. The player who is furthest ahead on each track earns 4 VPs and the second placed
player earns 2 VPs. In case of a tie for the first place, the tied players divide all the
available VPs (4 + 2) rounded down; the other players get nothing. In case of a tie for
the second place, the tied players divide 2 VPs, rounded down.
b. Each Development track has a Goal tile associated with it. You earn VPs based on
Goal criteria (Goal tile value) multiplied by the final position of your marker on the
track (multiplier). All players earn points from all 3 Development tracks in this way.
2. The VPs shown beneath the final position of your marker on the Domination track.
3. Any end game scoring criteria on God cards you have summoned.
4. Total all your Resources and Mana Crystals: you earn 1 VP for every 5 you have.
The player who has the most points wins! If there is a tie the player who is leftmost
ry from the first player wins.
